text: {"final": {"summary": "Added needs_review(household, score=None, today=None) to eligibility/rules.py. It returns False for non-active households (mirroring is_eligible), computes the vulnerability score when not provided, and returns True exactly when the household does not qualify but its score is within 5 points of the applicable threshold (55-59 for standard households, 40-44 for pregnant households). Households that already qualify are never flagged. Also added a NEAR_MISS_MARGIN constant; all existing code is unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
